welcome_to_websurf.subject: Welcome to WebSurf!
welcome_to_websurf.preview: Your new WebSurf email address is ready.

body.text: Welcome to WebSurf!
Your email address {{emailAddress}} has been created.
This inbox receives BubbleBodega order confirmations, Bubble Borough Bank statements and rewards, and messages from sites you discover while browsing WebSurf.

body.title: Your Inbox
body.text: New messages arrive here automatically as a result of activity in Bubble Borough.

body.title: Unread Mail
body.text: The notification badge on the WebSurf toolbar icon shows when unread mail is waiting for you.

welcome_to_bubble_borough.subject: Welcome to Bubble Borough
welcome_to_bubble_borough.preview: Your aquarium is ready. Let's get you started.

body.text: Welcome to Bubble Borough!
You have an empty tank and {{coin:startingCoins}}. Time to bring it to life.

body.title: Get Started
body.text: Purchased fish are automatically added to your active tank.

body.title: Care for Your Fish
body.text: Feed your fish twice a day and keep their needs met. Neglected fish can become unhealthy and eventually die.

body.title: Earn Fish Coins
body.text: Care for your fish, keep tanks clean, complete milestones, and check your daily recap to earn more coins.

items.label: Fish
items.text: View fish in your tank or storage.

items.label: Decor
items.text: Add, move, recolor, configure, and store decor. Save or load layouts.

items.label: Equipment
items.text: Manage automatic feeders, remote-control vehicles, and other equipment.

items.label: Background
items.text: Choose an image, solid color, gradient, or animated background. Use purchased images or upload your own. Animated backgrounds offer several colors to choose from.

items.label: Gravel
items.text: Customize the back, middle, and front gravel colors. The front layer is the most visible.

body.title: WebSurf
body.text: Browse WebSurf to shop at BubbleBodega, manage your Bubble Borough Bank account, and discover new sites.
For "{{milestoneRequirement}}", you have unlocked the {{milestoneName}} milestone.
{{coin:reward}} have been deposited into your account.

bubblebodega_rescue_offer.subject: A Fresh Start, On Us
bubblebodega_rescue_offer.preview: A Goldfish and one bottle of Basic Fish Food are waiting for you—free.

body.text: Let’s get your aquarium swimming again
BubbleBodega has reserved a complimentary Goldfish and one bottle of Basic Fish Food for your aquarium.
Use the offer below to add the food to your cart and view your free Goldfish. This email link can be used once; BubbleBodega will send a new offer if your aquarium needs another fresh start later.
